retrieval_documents.text: Mira crossed the old castle bridge and entered the stone keep.
A quiet garden grew behind the northern wall, full of herbs.
The archive held a map of the castle and its hidden passage.
Rain covered the harbor as sailors tied their boats to the pier.

writing_samples: Mira opened the gate. Rain tapped against the iron roof. She listened for footsteps.
The archive smelled of dust and cedar. A narrow map rested beneath the lamp. Mira folded it carefully.
